# ICC Fixture Notice

`PRMG_v2.0.1_MR.icc` is an International Color Consortium profile-library
fixture used by the Prompt 11B LittleCMS integration tests to exercise real
CMYK ICC-to-sRGB preview transforms.

Source: https://registry.color.org/profile-library/exchange-space-profile

The ICC profile library states that ICC-owned profiles may be copied,
distributed, embedded, made, used, and sold without restriction, provided
altered versions remove the original identification and copyright information
and are not misrepresented as the original profile.
